title: Validate charter processor lists after form normalization
summary: Client validation must inspect the same normalized lists that draftToForm submits, so separators and duplicates cannot change the server-facing limits.
hint_triggers: For the Concierge charter processor fields, reuse parseList in checkDraft and draftToForm. Apply the server lowercase ID pattern and 20-entry limit to normalized processor/purpose lists, validate each data category, and require either all three lists or none. Keep parseCharterForm authoritative; browser checks only give earlier feedback and disable review/proposal actions. Regression cases should include more than 20 repeated copies of one ID, 20 versus 21 unique IDs, whitespace/Japanese-comma separators, partial triples, and empty input. Exercise both owner preview and approver proposal: invalid drafts make zero POSTs, corrected drafts re-enable submission and serialize the intended arrays.
